title: mRemoteNG website is not working correctly
author: cheesecracker
body_snippet:
mRemoteNG website currently has issue.  Here are the steps:

1. Open the homepage at https://mremoteng.org/
2. Click on the download icon on top of the page. But the download page is blank.
3. Refresh the webpage.

After this refresh, a "404 found not found" is shown on the browser.

The same issue with Contribute as well.

I have tried Firefox and Chrome.
